title: Career Roadmap: ESG Analyst
summary: Career Domain: Environment, Energy & Sustainability · Qualification Pathway: BBA / BMS / BBM – BBA - Sustainability / ESG · Target Career: ESG Analyst

facts.Current degree: BBA / BMS / BBM (Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: An ESG Analyst measures how companies perform on environmental, social and governance issues - emissions, workers, boards, ethics - so investors and companies can manage risks and report honestly. SEBI's BRSR rules have made this a growing role in India.

items.text: Collect and analyse companies' ESG data and disclosures
Prepare ESG scores, reports and BRSR inputs
Track regulations and frameworks (BRSR, GRI, ISSB)
Advise on risks and improvement plans
Learn accounting, economics and environmental studies
Study BRSR, GRI and the GHG Protocol
Calculate a carbon footprint for a sample company
Intern with an ESG firm or a sustainability team
Write an ESG analysis of one listed company
CFA Institute ESG / Sustainable Investing certificate

blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
